about: Cases for node bench/style-check.mjs. The question: does the Concise output style save output tokens without damaging anything that is not prose? hard: true means a failure is a regression. Hard groups: code, verbatim, calibration, safety. The facts group is soft: its recall may drop at most 0.1. Write cases yourself and never paste real chat history.

cases.prompt: Give me the exact git command to undo my last commit but keep the changes staged. Reply with the command and one sentence.
What is the one-line shell command to find all files larger than 100MB under /var/log? Show the command.
Write a JavaScript function sum(a, b) and print sum(2, 3) with console.log. Reply with one code block.
Show the Dockerfile line that sets the working directory to /app. No files are available. Answer from your own knowledge.
Write a JavaScript function isEven(n). Print isEven(4) and isEven(7) on separate lines with console.log. Reply with one code block.
In one line: which npm command installs lodash as a dev dependency?
Repeat this sentence exactly, with nothing else and no quotes: The cache — warm for 59 minutes — expires at 10:00; it's the 'big' one.

checks.text: The cache — warm for 59 minutes — expires at 10:00; it's the 'big' one.

cases.prompt: Explica en dos frases qué hace un índice en una base de datos.
Write a short, warm email to a customer who got their order late. Apologize. Include a greeting and a sign-off.
Explain in a short paragraph why a database index speeds up reads but slows down writes.
What does the HTTP status code 429 mean, and how should a client react?
Review this code and list the bugs: function avg(a){ let s=0; for(let i=0;i<=a.length;i++){ s+=a[i]; } return s/a.length }
Give me a four-step plan to change a table column type with no downtime.
Explain the difference between a mutex and a semaphore.
Write a commit message for a change that fixes a null pointer in the login handler when the email is missing.
What is the exact latency of the production database at my company right now?
